the immunosuppressant tacrolimus has no beneficial effect in staphylococcus-induced T cell activation, systemic inflammatory response, and pneumonia.

the immunosuppressive effects of tacrolimus are not sufficient to protect from SAg-mediated TSS and pneumonia.
